chunks.text: SAMPLE TRAVEL ITINERARY • 14 DAYS / 13 NIGHTS South Korea Two-Week Travel Itinerary October 11 – October 24, 2027 • Autumn Foliage, Heritage & Coastal Route This two-week route connects South Korea's capital city of Seoul with the ancient Silla capital of Gyeongju, the port city of Busan, and the volcanic landscapes of Jeju Island. The itinerary progresses southward by KTX high-speed rail before returning to Seoul via domestic flight. Route & Transit Overview: Seoul (5 nights) → Gyeongju (2 nights) → Busan (3 nights) → Jeju Island (2 nights) → Seoul (1 night). Purchase a T-money card at Incheon Airport for subways and city buses nationwide. Week 1: Seoul Palaces, Markets & Ancient Gyeongju (October 11 – October 17, 2027) Day & Date City / DistrictDaily Schedule Day 1 Mon, Oct 11, 2027Arrival & Myeongdong (Seoul)Afternoon: Arrive at Incheon International Airport, pick up T-money cards and SIM/eSIM, and ride the AREX Express train to Seoul Station for hotel check-in.

Myeongdong (Seoul)Afternoon: Arrive at Incheon International Airport, pick up T-money cards and SIM/eSIM, and ride the AREX Express train to Seoul Station for hotel check-in. Evening: Evening walk along Cheonggyecheon Stream and street- food dinner in Myeongdong Night Market. Day 2 Tue, Oct 12, 2027Gyeongbokgung & Bukchon (Seoul)Morning: Watch the royal guard changing ceremony at Gyeongbokgung Palace and tour the palace grounds and National Folk Museum. Afternoon: Stroll the traditional wooden alleyways of Bukchon Hanok Village and browse galleries in Samcheong-dong. Evening: Traditional Korean table d'hote (hanjeongsik) dinner in Insadong. Day 3 Wed, Oct 13, 2027Changdeokgung & Gwangjang (Seoul)Morning: Guided tour of Changdeokgung Palace and its autumn- colored Secret Garden (Huwon). Afternoon: Lunch at Gwangjang Market (bindaetteok mung bean pancakes and knife-cut noodles), followed by a walk up Naksan Park's fortress wall. Evening: Explore Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) and night

pancakes and knife-cut noodles), followed by a walk up Naksan Park's fortress wall. Evening: Explore Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) and night shopping complexes. Day 4 Thu, Oct 14, 2027DMZ Excursion or Suwon Day TripMorning: Half-day guided tour to the Demilitarized Zone (Imjingak, Third Infiltration Tunnel, and Dora Observatory), or self-guided train trip to Suwon Hwaseong Fortress. Afternoon: Return to central Seoul for afternoon cafe hopping in Ikseon-dong hanok lanes. Evening: Ride the cable car up Namsan Mountain to N Seoul Tower for panoramic night views. South Korea 14-Day Travel Itinerary (October 11–24, 2027) Page 1 of 3

Day & Date City / DistrictDaily Schedule Day 5 Fri, Oct 15, 2027Hongdae & Seongsu-dong (Seoul)Morning: Coffee and independent design shops in Seongsu-dong, followed by a walk through Seoul Forest. Afternoon: Cross the city to Hongdae and Yeonnam-dong's Gyeongui Line Forest Park for indie boutiques and galleries. Evening: Korean BBQ dinner and live busking performances in Hongdae. Day 6 Sat, Oct 16, 2027Seoul → GyeongjuMorning: Board a morning KTX high-speed train from Seoul Station to Gyeongju Station (approx. 2 hours) and check into hotel. Afternoon: Walk through Daereungwon Royal Tomb Complex, Cheomseongdae Observatory, and Hwangnidan-gil street. Evening: Night reflection viewing at Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond. Day 7 Sun, Oct 17, 2027Gyeongju Heritage SitesMorning: Bus excursion to Mount Tohamsan to visit Bulguksa Temple and Seokguram Grotto. Afternoon: Explore Gyeongju National Museum and cross the wooden Woljeonggyo Bridge into Gyochon Traditional Village.

Temple and Seokguram Grotto. Afternoon: Explore Gyeongju National Museum and cross the wooden Woljeonggyo Bridge into Gyochon Traditional Village. Evening: Ssampab (leaf-wrapped rice meal) dinner near Hwangnidan-gil. Week 2: Coastal Busan, Jeju Island & Gangnam Return (October 18 – October 24, 2027) Day & Date City / DistrictDaily Schedule Day 8 Mon, Oct 18, 2027Gyeongju → BusanMorning: Take the KTX or intercity express bus south to Busan (approx. 35–50 minutes) and check in near Haeundae or Seomyeon. Afternoon: Walk along Haeundae Beach and ride the Haeundae Blueline Park Sky Capsule along the coast to Cheongsapo. Evening: Seafood dinner and Gwangan Bridge night lights at Gwangalli Beach. Day 9 Tue, Oct 19, 2027Old Busan & GamcheonMorning: Explore the hillside murals and terraced alleys of Gamcheon Culture Village. Afternoon: Sample fresh sashimi and grilled fish at Jagalchi Seafood Market, then browse BIFF Square and Gukje Market.

Gamcheon Culture Village. Afternoon: Sample fresh sashimi and grilled fish at Jagalchi Seafood Market, then browse BIFF Square and Gukje Market. Evening: Take the Songdo Marine Cable Car across the bay at dusk. Day 10 Wed, Oct 20, 2027East Coast BusanMorning: Visit seaside Haedong Yonggungsa Temple perched on coastal cliffs. Afternoon: Walk the coastal trails of Igidae Park overlooking Oryukdo Islets. Evening: Pork rice soup (dwaeji-gukbap) dinner in Seomyeon. South Korea 14-Day Travel Itinerary (October 11–24, 2027) Page 2 of 3

Day & Date City / DistrictDaily Schedule Day 11 Thu, Oct 21, 2027Busan → Jeju Island (East)Morning: Fly from Busan Gimhae Airport (PUS) to Jeju International Airport (CJU, approx. 1 hour); pick up rental car or hire a private taxi driver. Afternoon: Hike Seongsan Ilchulbong (Sunrise Peak) and walk the coastal ridge at Seopjikoji. Evening: Jeju black pork barbecue dinner in Jeju City or Seogwipo. Day 12 Fri, Oct 22, 2027Jeju Island (South & West)Morning: Visit Cheonjeyeon or Jeongbang Waterfall and the volcanic hexagonal basalt columns at Jusangjeolli Cliff. Afternoon: Tour Osulloc Tea Museum green tea fields and stroll Hallim Park or Hyeopjae Beach. Evening: Fresh abalone porridge and seafood hotpot at Dongmun Traditional Market. Day 13 Sat, Oct 23, 2027Jeju → Seoul (Gangnam)Morning: Fly from Jeju (CJU) to Seoul Gimpo Airport (GMP, approx. 1 hour 15 minutes) and transfer to Gangnam. Afternoon: Visit Bongeunsa Temple, Starfield COEX Library, and Garosu-gil tree-lined avenue.

1 hour 15 minutes) and transfer to Gangnam. Afternoon: Visit Bongeunsa Temple, Starfield COEX Library, and Garosu-gil tree-lined avenue. Evening: Farewell dinner in Gangnam or Apgujeong. Day 14 Sun, Oct 24, 2027Departure Morning: Last-minute skincare and snack shopping, hotel checkout, and tax-refund receipt preparation. Afternoon: Transfer via Airport Limousine Bus or AREX Express to Incheon International Airport (ICN) for departure flight. Practical Travel Notes Navigation Apps: Download Naver Map or KakaoMap before arrival, as standard international map apps have limited walking and transit routing in South Korea. Rail & Domestic Flights: Reserve KTX train tickets via KORAIL 30 days in advance and book Busan–Jeju–Seoul domestic flights early, as autumn weekends see high domestic travel demand. Jeju Transport: An International Driving Permit (IDP) is mandatory to rent a car on Jeju Island; otherwise, book a licensed Jeju day-tour taxi or use express trunk buses.

SAMPLE TRAVEL ITINERARY • 14 DAYS / 13 NIGHTS Tokyo Two-Week Travel Itinerary April 5 – April 18, 2027 • Spring Cherry Blossom & City Exploration Route This two-week itinerary balances Tokyo's historic temples, contemporary architecture, neighborhood food streets, and nearby day trips. Days are grouped geographically by train corridor to minimize transit transfers and maximize time on foot. Trip Overview & Logistics: Base accommodations in a central hub along the JR Yamanote Line (such as Shinjuku, Shibuya, or Ueno) for direct rail access across all wards. Pick up a rechargeable IC transit card (Suica or PASMO) at the airport upon arrival. Week 1: Historic East, Central Tokyo & Modern West (April 5 – April 11, 2027) Day & Date Primary DistrictDaily Schedule Day 1 Mon, Apr 5, 2027Arrival & ShinjukuAfternoon: Arrive at Haneda or Narita Airport, collect IC transit cards, and transfer by express train to central Tokyo for hotel check- in.

Day 1 Mon, Apr 5, 2027Arrival & ShinjukuAfternoon: Arrive at Haneda or Narita Airport, collect IC transit cards, and transfer by express train to central Tokyo for hotel check- in. Evening: Orientation walk through Shinjuku West Exit, dinner in Omoide Yokocho alley, and city views from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building observatory. Day 2 Tue, Apr 6, 2027Asakusa & UenoMorning: Early visit to Senso-ji Temple, Kaminarimon Gate, and Nakamise-dori shopping street. Afternoon: Walk to Ueno Park to stroll the cherry blossom promenade and visit the Tokyo National Museum. Evening: Casual street food and izakaya dinner under the tracks at Ameya-Yokocho Market. Day 3 Wed, Apr 7, 2027Tsukiji, Ginza & Imperial PalaceMorning: Fresh seafood breakfast and snack tasting at Tsukiji Outer Market. Afternoon: Walk through Hama-rikyu Gardens, then continue to the Imperial Palace East Gardens. Evening: Architecture stroll along Ginza Chuo-dori and dinner in the Yurakucho brick-arch corridor. Day 4

Imperial Palace East Gardens. Evening: Architecture stroll along Ginza Chuo-dori and dinner in the Yurakucho brick-arch corridor. Day 4 Thu, Apr 8, 2027Meiji Jingu, Harajuku & ShibuyaMorning: Walk through the forested grounds of Meiji Jingu Shrine and adjacent Yoyogi Park. Afternoon: Browse Takeshita Street, Cat Street, and the tree-lined boutiques of Omotesando. Evening: Cross Shibuya Scramble, sunset views from Shibuya Sky, and ramen in Nonbei Yokocho. Tokyo 14-Day Travel Itinerary (April 5–18, 2027) Page 1 of 3

Day & Date Primary DistrictDaily Schedule Day 5 Fri, Apr 9, 2027Akihabara & YanakaMorning: Explore traditional wooden townhouses, temples, and Yanaka Ginza shopping street. Afternoon: Visit Kanda Myojin Shrine and continue south into Akihabara Electric Town for electronics, retro games, and hobby shops. Evening: Dinner in Kanda or Jinbocho's historic bookshop district. Day 6 Sat, Apr 10, 2027Day Trip: Kamakura & EnoshimaMorning: Take the JR Yokosuka Line south (approx. 1 hour) to Kamakura; visit Kotoku-in (Great Buddha) and Hase-dera Temple. Afternoon: Ride the Enoden coastal tram to Enoshima Island for sea cliffs and shrine walks. Evening: Return to Tokyo for a relaxed neighborhood dinner. Day 7 Sun, Apr 11, 2027Nakameguro & DaikanyamaMorning: Coffee and bookstore browsing at Daikanyama T-Site. Afternoon: Walk along the Meguro River canal lined with independent boutiques and cafes. Evening: Dinner in Ebisu Yokocho food hall.

Afternoon: Walk along the Meguro River canal lined with independent boutiques and cafes. Evening: Dinner in Ebisu Yokocho food hall. Week 2: Bayfront, Mountain Excursions & West Suburbs (April 12 – April 18, 2027) Day & Date Primary DistrictDaily Schedule Day 8 Mon, Apr 12, 2027Toyosu & OdaibaMorning: Immersive digital art installations at teamLab Planets in Toyosu. Afternoon: Ride the automated Yurikamome Line across Rainbow Bridge to Odaiba Waterfront Park. Evening: Bayfront sunset views and dinner overlooking Tokyo Bay. Day 9 Tue, Apr 13, 2027Day Trip: NikkoMorning: Early Tobu Limited Express train from Asakusa (approx. 2 hours) to Nikko; tour the ornate Toshogu Shrine complex and Shinkyo Bridge. Afternoon: Bus up Irohazaka winding road to Lake Chuzenji and Kegon Falls. Evening: Return to Tokyo by evening train. Day 10 Wed, Apr 14, 2027Roppongi & Tokyo TowerMorning: Visit Zojo-ji Temple and take photos with Tokyo Tower in the background.

Kegon Falls. Evening: Return to Tokyo by evening train. Day 10 Wed, Apr 14, 2027Roppongi & Tokyo TowerMorning: Visit Zojo-ji Temple and take photos with Tokyo Tower in the background. Afternoon: Contemporary exhibitions at the Mori Art Museum or The National Art Center in Roppongi. Evening: Dinner in Azabu-Juban's traditional shopping neighborhood. Tokyo 14-Day Travel Itinerary (April 5–18, 2027) Page 2 of 3

Day & Date Primary DistrictDaily Schedule Day 11 Thu, Apr 15, 2027Kichijoji & ShimokitazawaMorning: Paddle boats and morning walk in Inokashira Park, Kichijoji. Afternoon: Ride the Keio Inokashira Line to Shimokitazawa for vintage clothing shops and independent coffee roasters. Evening: Soup curry dinner and live music venue visit in Shimokitazawa. Day 12 Fri, Apr 16, 2027Day Trip: Hakone / Mt. FujiMorning: Odakyu Romancecar from Shinjuku to Hakone-Yumoto; ride the mountain railway and cable car to Owakudani volcanic valley. Afternoon: Sightseeing cruise across Lake Ashi toward Hakone Shrine's lakeside torii gate. Evening: Optional day-use hot spring (onsen) soak before returning to Shinjuku. Day 13 Sat, Apr 17, 2027Kagurazaka & Last-Minute ShoppingMorning: Stroll the cobblestone backstreets of Kagurazaka and visit Akagi Shrine. Afternoon: Tax-free souvenir, stationery, and snack shopping at Itoya in Ginza or Shibuya Loft. Evening: Farewell dinner (kaiseki, yakiniku, or sushi counter).

Akagi Shrine. Afternoon: Tax-free souvenir, stationery, and snack shopping at Itoya in Ginza or Shibuya Loft. Evening: Farewell dinner (kaiseki, yakiniku, or sushi counter). Day 14 Sun, Apr 18, 2027Departure Morning: Pack luggage, check out of hotel, and pick up bento boxes at Tokyo or Shinagawa Station. Afternoon: Airport express train transfer to Haneda or Narita Airport for departure flight. Practical Travel Notes Advance Reservations: Book timed-entry tickets 3–4 weeks ahead for teamLab Planets, Shibuya Sky sunset slots, and limited express seats to Nikko and Hakone. Cash & Payments: Credit cards and IC cards are widely accepted in department stores and transit, though carrying ¥10,000–¥15,000 in cash is helpful for smaller shrines, street stalls, and ramen ticket machines. Luggage Forwarding: Use hotel-to-hotel or hotel-to-airport takkyubin courier services on Day 13 for heavy suitcases to simplify airport rail transfers.

SAMPLE TRAVEL ITINERARY • 21 DAYS / 20 NIGHTS Philippines Three-Week Travel Itinerary January 11 – January 31, 2027 • Dry-Season Highlands, Visayas & Palawan Island-Hopping Route This three-week route links Luzon's historic capital and mountain rice terraces with the Central Visayas islands of Cebu and Bohol, surf-and-lagoon life in Siargao, and the limestone archipelagos of Palawan. January falls squarely in the cool dry season, offering calm seas for fast-craft ferries and island-hopping boats. Inter-Island Route Overview: Manila (2 nights) → Banaue & Sagada (3 nights) → Cebu & Moalboal (3 nights) → Bohol (2 nights) → Siargao (3 nights) → El Nido (3 nights) → Coron (3 nights) → Manila (1 night). Week 1: Manila Heritage, Cordillera Highlands & Cebu Arrival (January 11 – January 17, 2027) Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 1 Mon, Jan 11, 2027Arrival in Manila (Luzon)Afternoon: Arrive at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL),

– January 17, 2027) Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 1 Mon, Jan 11, 2027Arrival in Manila (Luzon)Afternoon: Arrive at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL), pick up a local SIM/eSIM and PHP cash, and transfer to Makati or Bonifacio Global City (BGC) for check-in. Evening: Sunset walk along Ayala Triangle Gardens and introductory Filipino dinner (adobo, sinigang, and kare-kare). Day 2 Tue, Jan 12, 2027Intramuros & Binondo (Manila)Morning: Guided walking or bamboo-bike tour of walled Intramuros, including Fort Santiago and San Agustin Church. Afternoon: Cross the Pasig River into Binondo (the world's oldest Chinatown) for a dumpling and lumpia street-food crawl, followed by the National Museum of Fine Arts. Evening: Board an overnight sleeper bus (e.g., Ohayami Trans) from Sampaloc, Manila north to Banaue (approx. 9 hours). Day 3 Wed, Jan 13, 2027Banaue & Batad Rice TerracesMorning: Arrive in Banaue at dawn, check into a hillside

from Sampaloc, Manila north to Banaue (approx. 9 hours). Day 3 Wed, Jan 13, 2027Banaue & Batad Rice TerracesMorning: Arrive in Banaue at dawn, check into a hillside guesthouse, and ride a local jeepney to the Batad Saddle. Afternoon: Trek down into the amphitheater-shaped Batad Rice Terraces (UNESCO World Heritage Site) and continue to Tappiya Falls. Evening: Return to Banaue town for a warm mountain dinner. Day 4 Thu, Jan 14, 2027Banaue → SagadaMorning: Scenic mountain van transfer along the Halsema Highway corridor from Banaue to Sagada (approx. 2.5–3 hours). Afternoon: Walk Echo Valley to view the Hanging Coffins and explore Sumaguing Cave with an accredited local guide. Evening: Dinner at a pine-log cafe in Sagada town center. Philippines 21-Day Travel Itinerary (January 11–31, 2027) Page 1 of 4

Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 5 Fri, Jan 15, 2027Sagada → Baguio → ManilaMorning: Sunrise viewpoint walk at Kiltepan Peak or Marlboro Hills above a sea of clouds. Afternoon: Morning bus via Baguio connecting southward back to Manila (approx. 10–11 hours total transit). Evening: Check into an airport-adjacent hotel in Pasay for an early domestic flight. Day 6 Sat, Jan 16, 2027Manila → Cebu City → MoalboalMorning: Fly from Manila (MNL) to Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB, approx. 1 hour 20 minutes). Afternoon: Private van or South Bus Terminal transfer southwest across Cebu Island to Panagsama Beach, Moalboal (approx. 3 hours). Evening: Sunset snorkel right off the Panagsama house reef and beachfront seafood grill. Day 7 Sun, Jan 17, 2027Badian Canyoneering & MoalboalMorning: Guided Matutinao River canyoneering adventure in Badian ending at turquoise Kawasan Falls. Afternoon: Snorkel with the massive Moalboal sardine run and sea turtles along the Panagsama drop-off.

Badian ending at turquoise Kawasan Falls. Afternoon: Snorkel with the massive Moalboal sardine run and sea turtles along the Panagsama drop-off. Evening: Relaxed beachside dinner in Moalboal. Week 2: Cebu Heritage, Bohol Countryside & Siargao Island (January 18 – January 24, 2027) Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 8 Mon, Jan 18, 2027Moalboal → Cebu CityMorning: Morning transfer back to Cebu City. Afternoon: Visit Magellan's Cross, Basilica Minore del Santo Niño, Fort San Pedro, and Yap-Sandiego Ancestral House. Evening: Cebuano roast lechon dinner and city lookout views from Tops of Cebu on Mount Busay. Day 9 Tue, Jan 19, 2027Cebu → Bohol (Panglao)Morning: Board an OceanJet fast-craft ferry from Cebu Pier 1 to Tagbilaran Port, Bohol (approx. 2 hours); transfer to Alona Beach, Panglao. Afternoon: Afternoon swim and snorkel along Dumaluan Beach's white sandbar. Evening: Dinner at Bohol Bee Farm overlooking the sea. Day 10 Wed, Jan 20, 2027Bohol Interior &

Panglao. Afternoon: Afternoon swim and snorkel along Dumaluan Beach's white sandbar. Evening: Dinner at Bohol Bee Farm overlooking the sea. Day 10 Wed, Jan 20, 2027Bohol Interior & BalicasagMorning: Early boat trip to Balicasag Island Marine Sanctuary for reef wall snorkeling and Virgin Island sandbar. Afternoon: Countryside loop visiting the Chocolate Hills in Carmen, the Philippine Tarsier Sanctuary in Corella, and the Bilar Man-Made Forest. Evening: Sunset cruise along the Loboc River or dinner on Panglao. Philippines 21-Day Travel Itinerary (January 11–31, 2027) Page 2 of 4

Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 11 Thu, Jan 21, 2027Bohol → Cebu → SiargaoMorning: Morning ferry back to Cebu Pier 1 and transfer to Mactan-Cebu Airport (CEB). Afternoon: Afternoon turboprop flight to Sayak Airport, Siargao (IAO, approx. 1 hour); transfer south to General Luna. Evening: Sunset walk along Cloud 9 boardwalk and dinner on Tourism Road. Day 12 Fri, Jan 22, 2027Siargao Tri-Island HoppingMorning: Outrigger boat excursion to Naked Island sandbar and Daku Island. Afternoon: Fresh grilled seafood lunch under coconut palms on Daku Island, followed by snorkeling around Guyam Island. Evening: Casual dinner and live acoustic music in General Luna. Day 13 Sat, Jan 23, 2027North Siargao & Sugba LagoonMorning: Ride north through the Coconut Tree Viewdeck and Maasin River palm swing to Del Carmen. Afternoon: Paddleboard and kayak inside emerald Sugba Lagoon, then visit Magpupungko Rock Pools at low tide. Evening: Return to General Luna for dinner. Day 14

Maasin River palm swing to Del Carmen. Afternoon: Paddleboard and kayak inside emerald Sugba Lagoon, then visit Magpupungko Rock Pools at low tide. Evening: Return to General Luna for dinner. Day 14 Sun, Jan 24, 2027Siargao → Cebu → El NidoMorning: Fly from Siargao (IAO) via Cebu (CEB) directly into Lio Airport, El Nido, Palawan (ENI). Afternoon: Check into El Nido Town or Corong-Corong and unwind at Lio Beach. Evening: Sunset drinks at Las Cabañas Beach facing Bacuit Bay. Week 3: Palawan Karst Lagoons — El Nido & Coron (January 25 – January 31, 2027) Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 15 Mon, Jan 25, 2027El Nido Lagoon Tour AMorning: Full-day Bacuit Bay boat Tour A: kayak through the limestone walls of Big Lagoon and swim at Secret Lagoon. Afternoon: Beach picnic lunch on Shimizu Island and afternoon snorkeling at Seven Commandos Beach. Evening: Waterfront dinner in El Nido Town. Day 16 Tue, Jan 26, 2027El Nido Beaches &

Afternoon: Beach picnic lunch on Shimizu Island and afternoon snorkeling at Seven Commandos Beach. Evening: Waterfront dinner in El Nido Town. Day 16 Tue, Jan 26, 2027El Nido Beaches & Tour CMorning: Boat Tour C visiting Helicopter Island, Matinloc Shrine, and Hidden Beach. Afternoon: Late-afternoon tricycle ride north to wide, palm-lined Nacpan Beach. Evening: Return to Corong-Corong for dinner. Day 17 Wed, Jan 27, 2027El Nido → Coron (Fast Ferry)Morning: Morning fast ferry from El Nido Port across the Linapacan Strait to Coron Town, Busuanga (approx. 3.5–4 hours). Afternoon: Hotel check-in and late-afternoon climb up the 700 steps of Mount Tapyas for panoramic views of Coron Bay. Evening: Soak in the saltwater Maquinit Hot Springs nestled in mangroves. Philippines 21-Day Travel Itinerary (January 11–31, 2027) Page 3 of 4

Day & Date Island / Region Daily Schedule Day 18 Thu, Jan 28, 2027Coron Lakes & LagoonsMorning: Early boat departure to Kayangan Lake (crystal-clear freshwater lake ringed by karst cliffs) and Twin Lagoon. Afternoon: Snorkel the coral gardens of Siete Pecados Marine Park and lunch at Smith Beach. Evening: Dinner in Coron Town. Day 19 Fri, Jan 29, 2027Coron Reefs & ShipwrecksMorning: Snorkel or dive the shallow Lusong Gunboat shipwreck and vibrant Lusong Coral Garden. Afternoon: Island-hop to Pass Island or Malcapuya Island for white-sand beaches and clear turquoise shallows. Evening: Sunset seafood dinner overlooking Coron Harbor. Day 20 Sat, Jan 30, 2027Coron → ManilaMorning: Free morning in Coron Town for cashew nut souvenirs and local market browsing. Afternoon: Fly from Busuanga Airport (USU) to Manila (MNL, approx. 1 hour 15 minutes) and check into hotel. Evening: Farewell dinner in Poblacion (Makati) or Bonifacio High Street (BGC). Day 21 Sun, Jan 31, 2027Departure from

approx. 1 hour 15 minutes) and check into hotel. Evening: Farewell dinner in Poblacion (Makati) or Bonifacio High Street (BGC). Day 21 Sun, Jan 31, 2027Departure from ManilaMorning: Pack dry bags and souvenirs, check out of hotel, and allow extra buffer time for Metro Manila traffic. Afternoon: Transfer to Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL) for international departure flight. Practical Travel Notes Inter-Island Flights & Ferries: Book domestic flights (Philippine Airlines, Cebu Pacific, and AirSWIFT for direct El Nido routes) 6–8 weeks in advance, noting that turboprop flights to Siargao and Coron often enforce a strict 10–20 kg checked baggage limit. Cash & Connectivity: Carry sufficient Philippine Pesos (PHP) in smaller bills before traveling to Banaue, Sagada, Siargao, and El Nido, as ATMs in island towns can occasionally run out of cash or reject foreign cards.
